description: The Dragonfly finds its footing, Luke and Lorelai become a couple, and Rory’s relationship with Logan pulls her deeper into the privileged world her mother spent years resisting.

s05e01.description: Rory avoids discussing Dean with Lorelai and escapes to Europe with Emily, while Luke and Lorelai cautiously confirm that their new relationship is real.

s05e02.description: Rory returns from Europe and asks Lorelai to deliver a letter to Dean, which Lindsay finds and uses as the final reason to end their marriage.

s05e03.description: Luke takes Lorelai on their first official date and reveals he kept the horoscope she gave him years ago, while Rory meets the arrogant but intriguing Logan Huntzberger.

s05e04.description: Jackson challenges Taylor for town selectman as Rory and Dean struggle to restart their relationship under awkward post-divorce circumstances and Lane finally admits her feelings for Zack.

s05e05.description: A double date with Rory and Dean goes badly when Luke openly judges Dean as unworthy of Rory, sharpening tensions around the couple’s attempted reunion.

s05e06.description: Rory investigates Logan’s secret Yale society for the newspaper, Christopher turns to Lorelai after Sherry leaves for Paris, and Sookie realizes she is pregnant again.

s05e07.description: Rory joins Logan’s secret-society weekend and accepts his challenge to take a genuine risk, while Emily subjects Luke to a dinner designed to remind him of their class differences.

s05e08.description: Emily and Richard arrange a Yale party to steer Rory toward wealthier prospects, and Dean finally concludes that he no longer fits into Rory’s increasingly privileged world.

s05e09.description: Emily begins dating after separating from Richard, while Lorelai’s lunch with Christopher exposes unresolved tension between him and Rory and leaves Luke quietly uneasy.

s05e10.description: Rory gives a reckless Chilton student a Yale tour that spirals into trouble, while Marty finally makes clear that both he and Logan are interested in her.

s05e11.description: Lorelai comforts Christopher after his father dies but hides the visit from Luke, while a lost dog briefly brings the separated Emily and Richard back together.

s05e12.description: Richard and Emily reconcile and plan to renew their vows, while Emily privately urges Christopher to intervene before Lorelai and Luke become permanent.

s05e13.description: At Richard and Emily’s vow renewal, Christopher’s attempt to reclaim Lorelai provokes a confrontation with Luke, while Rory and Logan finally move beyond casual flirting.

s05e14.description: After Luke ends their relationship, Lorelai collapses emotionally and Rory returns from Yale to care for her while Stars Hollow awkwardly takes sides.

s05e15.description: Lorelai and Luke are forced into close contact while helping with a school musical, as Rory realizes Marty wants more from her than friendship but remains focused on Logan.

s05e16.description: Luke remains miserable after the breakup while Rory confronts Emily over her role in it, and Lane’s resentment toward Mrs. Kim reaches another breaking point.

s05e17.description: A themed Yale party pushes Rory and Logan into a more serious relationship, while Lorelai and Emily finally end their silence by resuming open conflict.

s05e18.description: Rory, Paris and Lane drink through their romantic frustrations while Luke becomes conspicuously invested in renovating the Twickham house, hinting at plans he has not voiced.

s05e19.description: Rory meets Logan’s family and is bluntly told she is unsuitable for him, while Luke takes over the Dragonfly kitchen during Sookie’s medically enforced bed rest.

s05e20.description: Rory begins an internship under Mitchum Huntzberger, Emily and Richard lavish attention on Logan at dinner, and Lorelai receives a tempting professional opportunity away from Stars Hollow.

s05e21.description: Mitchum tells Rory she lacks the instincts for journalism, devastating her confidence, while Sookie gives birth early and Luke loses his chance to buy the Twickham house.

s05e22.description: After stealing a yacht with Logan, Rory decides to leave Yale and move into her grandparents’ pool house, driving a painful break between her and Lorelai.
